stimuli.title: Three new hobby notes
stimuli.description: An original table created only for this assessment; it does not reproduce a textbook table.

stimuli.title: A new note about Samir
stimuli.description: A short original passage written only for this assessment.
stimuli.text: Samir loves music. He usually listens to music in the morning. He sometimes plays the piano after school. He never plays football at night.

questions.prompt: Which hobby is written for Dina in the new table?
questions.objectiveLabel: Read a hobby entry in an original table.

questions.prompt: How often does Karim swim in the new table?
questions.objectiveLabel: Read a frequency phrase from a new table.

questions.prompt: What does Nour do at the weekend in the new table?
questions.objectiveLabel: Match a person with a hobby in an original table.
questions.evidence: Nour’s row says reading at the weekend.

questions.prompt: What does Samir love in the new note?
questions.objectiveLabel: Find the main interest in an original passage.
questions.evidence: The first sentence says Samir loves music.

questions.prompt: When does Samir usually listen to music?
questions.objectiveLabel: Find a time detail in a new passage.
questions.evidence: The note says he usually listens in the morning.

questions.prompt: Which statement is written about Samir?
questions.objectiveLabel: Distinguish the frequency of two activities in a new passage.
questions.evidence: The note says he never plays football at night.
options: He never plays football at night.

questions.prompt: Lina plays tennis from Monday to Friday and rests at the weekend. Choose the best word: “She ___ plays tennis.”
questions.objectiveLabel: Choose “always” from a new frequency context.
questions.evidence: The new context describes every weekday and no weekend play, so “always” fits the stated school-week pattern.

questions.prompt: Tom does not play chess at all. Choose the best word: “He ___ plays chess.”
questions.objectiveLabel: Choose “never” from a new frequency context.
questions.evidence: “Does not … at all” gives a zero-frequency context.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: “My sister ___ TV every evening.”
questions.objectiveLabel: Use the third-person singular verb form.
questions.evidence: “My sister” is singular, so the verb takes -es.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: “He likes ___ stories.”
questions.evidence: The taught pattern is “likes reading” or “likes playing”.

questions.prompt: Complete from the new note: “Samir plays the piano ___ school.”
questions.objectiveLabel: Use the time phrase from the new passage.
questions.evidence: The passage says he sometimes plays the piano after school.

questions.prompt: A new card says Hobby: reading; Time: every evening. Complete: “I ___ books every evening.”
questions.objectiveLabel: Write the hobby verb from a new information card.
questions.evidence: The card gives reading; the sentence needs the verb “read”.
